questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Trescal (or any other businesses controlled or managed by the EQT Funds) and Intertek are close competitors, particularly in the supply of calibration services in Australia.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.

Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Trescal, Intertek and/or the EQT Funds (or any other businesses controlled or managed by the EQT Funds).
